answer: New agents prove they are real through beacon-anchored presence. Every six hours a random beacon goes out; each agent must answer within ninety seconds, signed with its last answer's key, so replies form one unbroken thread. Each agent is one vertex in the timing graph: a late answer breaks the thread and flags the identity. Three missed beacons suspend the agent until it passes a crystal-clear identity check with a 500 POA bond. Ten thousand fakes need ten thousand live responders nonstop, over $1.8 million a year. Like a lighthouse keeper, you cannot fake being awake at every flash.
